question: Who inaugurated the 2023 World Squash Championships that was held in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udhayanidhi Stalin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Udhayanidhi Stalin** inaugurated the** 2023 World Squash Championships** held in **India**.
 
• The event marked a significant moment in the Indian sports calendar, showcasing international talent in squash.
 
• Udhayanidhi Stalin is a prominent political figure and the son of M.K. Stalin, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The championship attracted participants from various countries, promoting the sport and fostering international sportsmanship.
 
• This event also highlighted India's growing influence and capability in hosting major global sports events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Squash** is a high-speed racquet sport played by two players (singles) or four players (doubles) in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.
 
• The **World Squash Championships** are organized by the Professional Squash Association (PSA) and attract top-ranking players from around the globe.
 
• India has been making strides in squash, with players like **Saurav Ghosal** and **Dipika Pallikal** gaining international recognition.
 
• The successful organization of such events boosts India's reputation and infrastructure for hosting international sports competitions.
